“Lift up your eyes to the bare heights, and see! Where have you not been lain with? You have sat waiting for them by…
I brought you into a plentiful land to eat its fruit and its goodness; but when you entered, you defiled my land, and…
who tell wood, ‘You are my father,’ and a stone, ‘You have given birth to me,’ for they have turned their back to me…
But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion. They, they are your lot. You have even poured a drink offering…
You also took your beautiful jewels of my gold and of my silver, which I had given you, and made for yourself images of…
My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them…
Woe to him who says to the wood, ‘Awake!’ or to the mute stone, ‘Arise!’ Shall this teach? Behold, it is overlaid with…

translations.web: Because she took her prostitution lightly, the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with wood.
translations.bsb: Indifferent to her own infidelity, Israel had defiled the land and committed adultery with stones and trees.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that she defiled the land, and committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
translations.asv: And it came to pass through the lightness of her whoredom, that the land was polluted, and she committed adultery with stones and with stocks.
